name: zennify-dma
description: Zennify Digital Maturity Assessment tooling: the skills, agents and connector that produce and audit DMA Insights surfaces.

plugins.name: dma-insights
plugins.description: The six DMA skills, the 47-agent roster with explicit tool allow-lists, two operator commands, submit/verdict/promote hooks and the remote DMA Insights MCP connector (33 tools). The pre-synthesis gate walks the pending queue, not a hardcoded client list. An evidence excerpt is read from a register column or left absent, never scavenged.
